messages:
Alex W: incident-bot just paged me for high KV cache churn on prod-rope-ntk pool. 99th latency spiking, some token throttles. Anyone else seeing this?

incident-bot: [pager] incident opened: #INC-1971 - kv-prefetch-feedback-loop detected. Pager assigned: Alex W

Alex W: sharing grafana link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/Rope/kv-churn?panelId=5
Top metrics: kv_size ~ 3.2M entries (normal ~200k). continuous_batch enqueue rate doubled.

Maria R: seeing same. zpool prefetch job kicked at ~1971233500, sliding-window prefetch growth rate ~8x. Might be a feedback loop between prefetch and rope-extension.

Kevin L: logs from runtime show repeated prefix cache misses then prefetch enqueues. sample log:
```
2026-03-14T22:12:03Z INFO prefetch.enqueue key=ctx:rope:ntk:abcd1234
2026-03-14T22:12:03Z DEBUG kv.get miss key=ctx:rope:ntk:abcd1234 enqueue
2026-03-14T22:12:03Z INFO prefetch.enqueue key=ctx:rope:ntk:efgh5678
```

Sophie T: customer-impact: two enterprise customers reported elevated tail-latency, some requests hitting 5-6s. Not seeing widespread errors, but UX impacted.

Alex W: marking impact: partial degradation (tail latency increased, successful but slow). Routing will be affected if it continues.

PD Bot: @Alex W acknowledged. Handoff?

Alex W: Maria, Kevin oncall. quick mitigation ideas: 1) throttle prefetch by rate-limit, 2) disable sliding-window flag, 3) rollback recent rollout that changed continuous_batch window.

Maria R: I can flip prefetch throttle quickly. Patch: `service.api.v1.prefetch.max_concurrent = 50` (current 500). Applying now.

Maria R: applied throttle on prod-rope-ntk (command):
```
$ rctl set -p prod-rope-ntk prefetch.max_concurrent=50
OK
```
Metrics should show drop in enqueue rate in ~30s.

Kevin L: also enabling aggressive kv eviction policy to free hot cache: `kv.eviction.strategy=age_based,kv.eviction.max_age_secs=300`.

Kevin L: applied eviction. Monitor shows kv_size dropping from 3.2M -> 1.1M in 2m.

Alex W: good. tail latency 99th went from ~4.8s -> ~1.8s within ~120s. Customers reporting improvement. Still want to rollback that continuous_batch change.

Maria R: found rollout PR that changed `continuous_batch.window = adaptive` -> allowed runaway growth with sliding-window. Rolling back to `fixed=64` now.

Maria R: rollback completed. Confirming no new prefetch enqueues. :eyes: 

Sophie T: Customer comms draft: "We observed elevated tail latency due to an experimental prefetch/long-context interaction. We've applied throttles and rolled back the config. Monitoring shows recovery. We'll follow up with RCA and mitigation plan." Sending now.

Alex W: adding short mitigation note to incident ticket #INC-1971. Root cause hypothesis: sliding-window prefetch + adaptive continuous_batch produced a positive feedback loop when NTK lengths increased, causing prefetch thrashing and kv overpopulation.

incident-bot: Incident #INC-1971 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Assigned: Alex W, Maria R, Kevin L. ETA RCA start 24h.

Kevin L: next steps: run repro harness on staging with longctx NTKs and sliding-window enabled to find the threshold. Add runtime guard: refuse prefetch when kv_size > 1M and enqueue_rate > 200/s.

Alex W: agreed. will schedule postmortem and follow-ups (add guard, throttle defaults, hard-off flag for sliding-window in prod). Tagging SRE and ML-runtime teams. :thumbsup:
